```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Read in data

```{r}
karen <- read.csv("full-names-data-nice.csv")
```

# Find Correlation for Devon

```{r}
# Filter down to male Devons in USA
devon_us <- karen %>%
  filter(name == "Devon", sex == "Boy", country == "United States")

# Filter down to male Devons in England/Wales
devon_eng <- karen %>%
  filter(name == "Devon", sex == "Boy", country == "England/Wales")

# Find the years which both dfs have in common
common_yrs_devon <- Reduce(intersect, list(unique(devon_us$year), unique(devon_eng$year)))

# Filter Devons in US to just common years
devon_us <- devon_us %>%
  filter(year %in% common_yrs_devon)

# Filter Devons in England/Wales to just common years
devon_eng <- devon_eng %>%
  filter(year %in% common_yrs_devon)

# Find correlation
helperCor(devon_us, devon_eng)
```

# Find Correlation for Jordan

```{r}
# Filter down to male Jordans in USA
jordan_us <- karen %>%
  filter(name == "Jordan", sex == "Girl", country == "United States")

# Filter down to male Jordans in England/Wales  
jordan_eng <- karen %>%
  filter(name == "Jordan", sex == "Girl", country == "England/Wales")

# Find the years which both dfs have in common
common_yrs_jordan <- Reduce(intersect, list(unique(jordan_us$year), unique(jordan_eng$year)))

# Filter Jordans in US to just common years
jordan_us <- jordan_us %>%
  filter(year %in% common_yrs_jordan)

# Filter Jordans in England/Wales to just common years
devon_eng <- jordan_eng %>%
  filter(year %in% common_yrs_jordan)

# Find correlation
helperCor(jordan_us, jordan_eng)
```
